findings.claim: The README tells learners to do the one-time setup (npm ci with an about 200 MB Chromium download) 'before the block', but on S25 there is no slot for it: the cap equals the whole 40-minute Faded then fresh block, and intake section Minute budgets assigns every other S25 block (Concept row: Warm-up, Reading, video, Worked example, Short exercises, Mini-quiz, Reflection; 'Remaining 7 of Short exercises and Faded then fresh 40: platform coding practice'). Unlike S21 (62 minus 55) and S26 (54 minus 45), S25 leaves no in-block slack, so a learner who arrives without setup done loses the buffer to the download. Evidence: README line 3 and Setup step 2; lab.json minutes {estimatedMedian 34, cap 40}; intake.md Minute budgets row 'S20, S22, S24, S25 | Concept'.
findings.recommendation: Say when setup happens, for example 'at the end of S24 or before S25 starts', or name the remaining 7 minutes of S25 Short exercises as the setup slot.

findings.claim: 'they do not check `main`-less details such as variable names' is unclear: `main` reads as a code identifier or the HTML element, and learners cannot tell what is out of scope. Evidence: README line 16, unchanged since 4523b538.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite as 'and they do not check minor details such as variable names'.
